scope: Add an explicit, independent sedzia-ci owner-env trust slot without weakening the two-domain threshold

tests.expect: BRAUN_SEDZIA_CI_PUBKEY is normalized and mapped only to domain sedzia-ci
Astra plus either Brat or sedzia-ci is READY; Astra alone, sedzia-ci alone, or Brat plus sedzia-ci without Astra remains DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
All present public keys must be valid and pairwise distinct; a malformed or duplicated third key fails closed with an explicit reason
A sedzia-ci signature is accepted only when lineage_ref starts with sedzia-ci-run- and is rejected otherwise
Two signed EFFECT statements remain mandatory and must have distinct domains, lineages, statement ids, matching cycle and matching subject
The R5 Astra plus Brat path remains READY and EFFECT_VERIFIED
The full frozen R5 suite and mutants remain green; PREPARE_ONLY, STOP, transactional installer, evidence create-only and rollback behavior are unchanged
